sources.entry: ShortsKit.ai - AI-powered platform for creating short-form videos

summary.name: ShortsKit.ai
summary.one_liner: ShortsKit.ai is an AI video creation platform that turns a text idea into short-form vertical videos with AI visuals, AI voiceovers and auto-synced captions.
use_cases: Creating faceless YouTube Shorts from a text idea
Producing TikTok videos without a camera
Making Instagram Reels with AI voiceover and captions
Generating short ad or UGC-style clips
Batch-producing short videos from reusable templates
summary.what_it_does: The platform takes a written topic, hook or style and generates AI visuals (images or videos) for a short clip, with the duration adjustable from 8 to 160 seconds. It adds AI narration with selectable voice styles, background soundtrack options, and captions that are automatically synced with customizable presets and styling. Users can generate multiple clips or start from templates, then edit timing, captions and effects in a built-in timeline editor. Export is optimized for 9:16 formats for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels. The page lists several third-party video models (such as Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Kling and LTX) as options.
notable: Faceless video creation: AI generates visuals, voiceover and captions with no filming or editing skills needed
Credit-based plans from $15/month with unlimited exports and no watermark
Choice of multiple AI video models and reusable templates
Built-in timeline editor for captions, transitions, music and voiceover
caveats: Paid subscriptions only; plans are priced per month (listed $15, $39, $159) excluding VAT, and video output is limited by monthly credits
Plan figures are approximate (about 15, 40 or 200 videos per month)
Page does not say whether a free trial or free tier exists
